Lemni, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json. The marketing site is Framer and publishes no colour-token palette, so the roles are computed styles from the live pages on 2026-11-18. Light is the inner pages (pricing, docs, blog, company, brand, changelog, support, privacy) and the sign-in shell. Dark is the home page only. The header toggle sets data-mode on <html>. TWK Lausanne is not loaded here.

Signed out. The agent builder, knowledge, actions, inbox and billing sit behind https://lemni.com/signin and were not opened.

Colour

Page, surface, raised, action and field are the backgrounds that actually paint. Text is primary, secondary, muted, on-action and link. The violet chip and the declared link blue sit in the core ramp, not as the button accent. The button accent is black on light pages and a glass black pill on the home page.

Ink ramp

Typography

Display is TWK Lausanne 250 at 94 px on the home hero and 76 px on pricing. The 250 weight is the family name; the computed weight is 400. UI labels are 15 px. Footer and docs side links are 13 px TWK Lausanne 300. The sign-in title is system-ui 32 px / 500.

Space and shape

Measured steps are 20 px (light nav padding), 40 px (control height) and 50 px (desktop nav height). 8, 12 and 16 px are a derived 4 px base, marked as such in the tokens. Radii are 0, 12 px on the auth card, 40 px on light pills and 140 px on the dark glass pill.

Radius

Elevation

Four measured shadows, each tied to a control: the dark glass pill, the light plan button, the email field, and the auth Continue button. The marketing pages do not stack cards with drop shadows.

Motion

Home runs a 1 s dots loop on twelve elements. Sign-in moves three elements at 100 to 200 ms. Pricing and docs are still. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the probe kept all 15 moving elements, including the loop. Click a track to play it.

Components

Drawn from the tokens. Crops of the real controls are in components/crops/.
